title: Warp arrival settle
hypothesis: Holding observations until the game's door/stairs/warp task releases the player shows the model the arrival tile on the new map with field controls free, instead of a mid-animation frame labelled as a dialog/menu/script lock, so runs stop wasting turns on locked doorways and re-entering maps they never knew they reached (control-2919 T100, T143, T185, T200-T247), and reach later milestones sooner.
notes: Pre-launch fix F1 (M4 of docs/worklogs/active/2026-10-16_prelaunch-fixes.md); operator decision 2026-10-16 12:46 AM EDT: to be ON in the bundle arm of bundle-v-control only, measured as part of the treatment. Not yet wired: experiments/fixed/bundle-v-control.json on this branch does not list warp-arrival-settle-v1 (neither in base.features nor in switches), so both arms currently run it OFF; the M6 integration adds it to the bundle arm's switches (with false in base.features). This standalone entry is registered pending per the feature-switch rule. It acts at the first warp after the new game (truck -> Littleroot). Evidence: control-2919 archived RAM seq 1383/2010/2884/3165/3166 (lock + warp task, no fade); real-ROM probes 2026-10-16 (lab door: OFF captured LITTLEROOT (7,16) locked, ON waited 82 frames and captured the LAB (6,12) unlocked). Provisional source.commit 2221255 (branch claude/warp-arrival-settle, the RED test commit; the implementation is the next commit). It is repinned to the merge SHA on main with `just experiment-pin` when the branch lands; until then this entry is not reproducible from main.
